answers.genPolicy:e5e76049de0091dd0f40c55e414a32:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA
=> < deviceA | ... > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret ; CurrentTime) .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (Secret ; IssuedAt)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) if IssuedAt == CurrentTime .
[B4] < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (KnownSecrets) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret , KnownSecrets) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : nils , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ...) , ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : Owners , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'joinDevice' cloudA | (Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : Tickets , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : nils , 'issuedAt' : nils , ...) , ... > if CurrentTime - IssuedAt > 2 .
